body.name: Explicit fifth-date restricted score construction
body.construction:
For a law \(P\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{5d}}\), let \(\mathcal S_P=\{s:p_s>0\}\) be its actual observed support.  On a fixed structural support stratum, form a finite structural chart \(\beta\) as follows.  Its coordinates are one-omitted-category coordinates for the cohort probabilities \(\delta_d=P(D=d)\), the conditional type probabilities \(\pi_j^d\), the initial probabilities \(\mu_j^d(x)=P(X_0=x\mid Z=j,D=d)\), and every nondegenerate row of \(H_j^d,Q_j,U_j,V_j,L_j\) and of an unrestricted treated date-\(4\) kernel \(T_{4,j}^1\).  All coordinates forbidden by \(\mathcal G\), all absorbing rows, and all zero coordinates defining the stratum are held fixed; omitted coordinates are filled by the row-sum-one constraints.  Write \(T_{3,j}^0=U_j\), \(T_{3,j}^1=V_j\), and \(T_{4,j}^0=L_j\).  For \(s=(d,x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4)\in\mathcal S_P\), define the observed-cell factor map
\[
 q_s(\beta)=\delta_d\sum_{j=1}^2\pi_j^d\mu_j^d(x_0)
 H_j^d[x_0,x_1]Q_j[x_1,x_2]
 T_{3,j}^d[x_2,x_3]T_{4,j}^d[x_3,x_4].
\]
All occurrences of \(Q_j\) share the same coordinates across cohorts.  The coordinates \(U_j\) and \(L_j\) appearing in observed control cells also parameterize the treated cohort's untreated counterfactual kernels; those counterfactual copies are observationally null but impose the full-data common-kernel restrictions.  At \(P\), differentiate this displayed polynomial map with respect to every free chart coordinate.  If its Jacobian has rank \(k_P\), retain any \(k_P\) independent columns spanning its column space and call the resulting \(|\mathcal S_P|\times k_P\) matrix \(A_P\).  Define
\[
 W_P=\operatorname{diag}\{p_s:s\in\mathcal S_P\},
 \qquad S_P=W_P^{-1}A_P.
\]
The handle \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{eff}}\) is this finite factor-map, Jacobian-selection, and weighted-score construction.  Observationally null coordinates of the full-data law are discarded before the independent columns are selected.
